_comment: Valid and invalid instances for relationships.oojs.json — all four combinations of cardinality × structure (§8.7).

valid._comment: All four relationships present. address: has-one vertical (embedded). badges: has-many vertical (embedded array). department: has-one horizontal (ID ref via refType). projects: has-many horizontal (ID array via refType).
valid.name: Alice

valid._comment: Only required fields: employeeId, name, department. The optional relationships (address, badges, projects) may be omitted.
valid.name: Bob

valid._comment: Has-one vertical present, has-many vertical empty array, has-many horizontal with one entry.
valid.name: Carol

valid._comment: Has-many vertical with a single badge. Verifies minItems defaults to 0 (zero-or-more is valid).
valid.name: Dave

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-one horizontal): department is required but absent. The owning side of a horizontal relationship must always carry the reference.
invalid.name: Missing Department

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-one vertical): address is present but the embedded Address is missing its required 'street' field.
invalid.name: Bad Address

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-many vertical): one Badge in the array is missing its required 'label' field.
invalid.name: Bad Badge

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-one horizontal): department must be a string (ID), not an integer.
invalid.name: Bad Dept Type

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-many horizontal): each element of projects must be a string (ID). An integer ID is not valid.
invalid.name: Bad Project IDs

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-many vertical): badges must be an array, not an object.
invalid.name: Badges Not Array

invalid._comment: ERROR (has-one horizontal): department must be a string ID, not an embedded Department object. Use refType for horizontal references.
invalid.name: Embedded Dept
